summary.text: Kari Rehrauer is a Democratic state representative from Minnesota House District 35B who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former science teacher, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that her priorities include preventing fraud, affordability and education funding.

paragraphs.text: Kari Rehrauer earned a bachelor's degree and a graduate degree from the University of Minnesota, Twin Cities, and her career experience includes working as a science teacher.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she was raised in Eau Claire, Wisconsin, spent 20 years as a public school teacher, and served four years on the Coon Rapids City Council.
Rehrauer assumed office on January 14, 2025, succeeding Jerry Newton.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Education Finance, Housing Finance and Policy, and Labor, Industry, Veterans and Military Affairs Finance and Policy committees.
She said her key messages are stopping fraud before it starts, making health care, child care and housing more affordable, and returning to a state funding model for schools.
